comment: Single chlorination of griseophenone C in the griseofulvin pathway yielding griseophenone B.

reactions.description: Single chlorination of griseophenone C yielding griseophenone B.
Single chlorination of C2 in griseophenone C to yield griseophenone B

Dichlorination of griseophenone C yielding griseophenone G. Only occurs in small amounts and only if GsfF was knocked out. Cytochrome P450 GsfF catalyzes the intramolecular coupling reaction of griseophenone B.
Dichlorination of C2, C4 in griseophenone C to yield griseophenone G
